notes: SYNTHETIC. Generated by ndz.validation.synthetic.make_multisubject(n_subjects=4, n_samples=200, seed=7, target_rho=0.99, shared_weight=0.15) (2 recordings per subject, default drift) and ndz.validation.gap.validation_gap(..., metric='pearson_r', n_boot=500, seed=0) with the current scoring (each subject scored once on pooled out-of-fold predictions). Used by tests only; contains no real data.
To exercise optional fields in the schema, the main pipeline leaves out held_out_recording and has its purged_random confidence interval set to null; the variant has all five protocols.
